---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What problem would this solve?**
A clear description of the problem or gap. Ex: "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you'd want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've thought about.

**Additional context**
Mockups, links, or examples from other tools, if helpful.

---
Note: this project doesn't accept pull requests (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)),
so feature requests are implemented by the maintainer at their discretion, if at all. Filing one
here is still the right way to suggest it.
